title: Vehicle Standards by Parking License Product
content:
Community parking standards: every Parking License product sets the vehicle it will accept — its size, its registration and its kind — and whether household items may be kept in the space.

## Size limits

| Parking product | Maximum vehicle length | Clearance limit of the space | Over-standard-size vehicles (dual-rear-wheel trucks, trailers, RVs) allowed |
|---|---|---|---|
| Surface Unreserved Permit | 22 ft | 13.5 ft | Yes |
| Surface Reserved Space | 20 ft | 13.5 ft | No |
| Covered Carport Space | 19 ft | 8.5 ft | No |
| Structured Garage Space | 18 ft | 6.9 ft | No |
| EV Charging Reserved Space | 19 ft | 7.0 ft | No |
| Private Detached Garage | 22 ft | 7.5 ft | Yes |

## Registration, vehicle kind and use of the space

| Parking product | Current state registration in a household member's name required | Vehicles registered per license | Motorcycles allowed | Household items may be stored in the space |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Surface Unreserved Permit | Yes | 1 | Yes | No |
| Surface Reserved Space | Yes | 1 | Yes | No |
| Covered Carport Space | Yes | 1 | Yes | No |
| Structured Garage Space | Yes | 1 | Yes | No |
| EV Charging Reserved Space | Yes | 1 | Yes | No |
| Private Detached Garage | Yes | 1 | Yes | Yes |

## Illustrations (hypothetical vehicles)

- A hypothetical pickup 19.5 ft long and 7.2 ft high exceeds the 19 ft length of the Covered Carport Space and the 6.9 ft clearance of the Structured Garage Space; it fits the 20 ft length and 13.5 ft clearance of the Surface Reserved Space.
- A hypothetical travel trailer is an over-standard-size vehicle: of the six products, only the Surface Unreserved Permit and the Private Detached Garage show "Yes".
- The Private Detached Garage is the only product whose space may hold household items.
